No distinct second pistol was established in the four new aiming figures or the earlier scoped holster inspections. Far RIGHT holster entrance/interior is partly occluded; no blanket empty-interior certificate for all forty poses is made.
The near LEFT open pouch is an original storage detail, not a canonical MGS1 extra-pouch claim. Other concealed storage shapes remain visibility qualifications, not selectively masked source pixels.
